prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1114; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving in the right lane on a busy road in Conroe, Texas, when I signaled and began moving left to change lanes. As I merged, a vehicle in the left lane moved over into the same space and its side made contact with the side of my car. Both of us pulled onto the shoulder right after impact. The contact scraped along my driver side panel and cracked the side mirror housing. Neither vehicle had airbags deploy, and both drivers were able to exit under their own power. Later that afternoon I began feeling stiffness and a sharp pain in my lower back, which I believe came from the jolt of the impact as my body pulled against the seatbelt. I have since sought medical care for a back strain and am following the treatment plan. I am providing this account so the claim can be documented accurately.
